description: Lint dependency manifests for hygiene: unpinned, wildcard or unbounded versions, missing lockfiles, git/URL deps, non-https indexes, install scripts, dependency-confusion names, plus a small static snapshot of famous compromised versions (not a live CVE feed). Use this for a few manifests you can paste; use supply_chain_scan instead for a whole repo ZIP, other lockfiles or MCP configs. Send exactly one of manifests (1-20 files) or upload_id + filename; neither or both is 400 manifests_xor_upload_id_required. Reads package.json, package-lock.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, Pipfile, go.mod, Gemfile, composer.json, pubspec.yaml; other files become an unsupported_file finding. Read-only, deterministic, no network, nothing installed or run. Free (0 credits), Bearer key required. Returns findings with severity, category and fix, a 0-100 score, grade A-F and per-severity counts.

filename.description: Required with upload_id, e.g. package.json: the file name decides how the content is parsed.

manifests.description: 1 to 20 manifest files inline, each up to 500,000 characters. Send exactly one of manifests or upload_id.

filename.description: File name, e.g. package.json; drives type detection.

upload_id.description: Instead of manifests: one manifest uploaded via the create_upload tool (your own uploads only). Send exactly one of manifests or upload_id.

name: dependency_check
